is: The library's lamp: the light a scene inventory row gives when its row kind glows (score/stages/row_kinds.py, data/checks/row-kinds.json), by how its row is mounted (the row's `anchor`: ceiling, wall, at its head when its own metres are a stem's, at least three times as tall as wide (tools/props/scene/lamps.py STEM), else it stands on something; a reading's row anchored `on:<row>` is mounted as that row is, by a word of its noun, else of its own anchor, in `mount_words`, else at its head when that row's metres are a stem's, else by what that row is on in turn). `high`: where on its piece the light sits, a share of the piece's height; `reach_per_height`: its reach in metres per metre its laid pieces hang above the floor, never under `least_reach`; `strength_per_reach`: its starting strength (a share of the game lamp's energy, tools/usd/scene.LAMP_ENERGY) per metre of reach, which the light sweep then measures against the concept (score/stages/light); `shadows`: whether it casts them. `aimed`: the lamp of a glowing row its scene's plan aims at a plan item (the plan's `aims`): a spot `angle` degrees wide, its reach `reach_per_aim` times its distance to what it aims at, its strength `strength_per_reach` (the same share) per metre of reach, its colour and fall-off, and the shaft of haze it lights (tools/usd/scene.write_shafts). Read by tools/props/scene/lamps.py for every kit's kinds table, and for a kit-shell scene's lamps by the scene-record row (score/stages/scene_record/kit_shell.py). Every entry is general: a mount, never a scene's name.
from: 2026-10-21: the medians, per mount, of the 35 lamp rows' hand-typed numbers it replaces (reach over the laid height, strength over reach; the ceiling's shadows were the hub's roof fixture's alone)

head.from: 2026-10-25: a lamp on a stem (its own metres, or those of the row it stands on, at least three times as tall as wide: a street lamp, a floodlight tower, a floor lamp; never its words) shines from its head at the top of its model, not its middle; the stands mount's reach and strength, raised to the head, and its shadows cast as a street lamp's are (the light sweep measures the strength after)

fill.from: 2026-10-25 (owner: "the frame work should solve this, look at the concept"): the light a concept shows falling on a place from no source in view (its reading's `unseen`, score/review/reading.py LIGHT_ASKED), in the colour it shows: under the open sky a soft distant light from straight overhead `size` degrees wide, inside a shell a sphere light `radius` metres wide over the place's middle at `high` of its ceiling, reaching half its width. Its strength starts at `energy` and the light sweep sets it, after the place's own lamps, to bring the place to its concept's brightness (score/stages/light)

aimed.from: 2026-10-21: the medians of the two aimed lamp rows' hand-typed numbers it replaces (the sky record's earth lamps far_floodlight_tower and far_pad_floodlight: angle, range over their distance to what they aim at, energy over the game lamp's over range), their shaft and colour the same in both
